title: Package Management with pip 📦
description: Install, upgrade, and manage the external libraries that power hacking tools.

slides.title: Your Hacking Arsenal Comes from pip
slides.content:
# Python's Package Installer

`pip` is the standard tool for installing Python packages from the [Python Package Index (PyPI)](https://pypi.org). Want a library to make HTTP requests? `pip install requests`. Want to parse HTML? `pip install beautifulsoup4`.

Every hacking tool you'll build depends on `pip`.

slides.title: Checking pip Installation
slides.content:
# Is pip Already There?

Usually, pip comes bundled with Python. Verify:
```
pip --version
```
or
```
pip3 --version
```
If not, you can install it via `python -m ensurepip --upgrade`. But on most systems it's ready.

quizData.question: pip can only install packages that come with Python by default.
quizData.explanation: pip downloads and installs third‑party packages from PyPI, extending Python's capabilities.

slides.title: The Basics: install, uninstall, list
slides.content:
# Essential pip Commands

* **Install the latest version:** `pip install package_name`
* **Install a specific version:** `pip install package_name==1.2.3`
* **Upgrade a package:** `pip install --upgrade package_name`
* **Uninstall:** `pip uninstall package_name`
* **List installed:** `pip list`
* **Show details:** `pip show package_name`

slides.title: Try It in Your Venv
slides.codeSnippet:
pip install requests
pip list
pip show requests

quizData.question: Which command removes a package entirely?
quizData.explanation: `pip uninstall` is the correct sub‑command to remove a package.

slides.title: Freezing Dependencies ❄️
slides.content:
# Share Your Exact Environment

When you build a hacking tool and want to share it, others need the same libraries. Use:
```
pip freeze > requirements.txt
```
This creates a `requirements.txt` file listing every package and its version. To recreate the environment, someone (or you) runs:
```
pip install -r requirements.txt
```
This is standard practice in professional tools.

quizData.question: What is the purpose of `pip freeze > requirements.txt`?

options.text: To save the current environment's package list for later replication
To upgrade all packages at once

quizData.explanation: It records exact versions, making the project reproducible.

slides.title: Watch Out: Global vs Venv pip
slides.content:
## Always Check Activation

If you run `pip install` without activating a venv, you'll install to the **global** Python. On some systems that requires admin rights and can cause conflicts. Always ensure `(env_name)` is in your prompt before installing anything.

slides.title: Upgrading pip Itself
slides.content:
# Stay Current

Even pip needs updates. Run:
```
pip install --upgrade pip
```
This ensures you have the latest features and security fixes.

slides.title: Pro Tip 💡
slides.content:
## Using `python -m pip`

If `pip` command is not found, you can always use:
```
python -m pip install package
```
This invokes pip via the Python interpreter, which is especially reliable.
